text: first of all the price is ridiculous... started the pro trial saw how difficult the app was so I went to delete the app and make sure the subscription was stopped and would not get more charges the step I am on now is the most aggravating because the app all of a sudden is saying it is not responding maybe I'll get a response on here but least of all I will have some documentation if anyone has some type of way to contact thses ppl plz let me know I have had to deal with Google pay refund
replyText: Hi Adam, sorry for the frustration. Deleting the app doesn’t cancel a subscription. To cancel: Google Play > Profile > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > Voiskey > Cancel. For any further help, email official@voiskey.ai and we’ll sort it out. We’re also investigating the “not responding” issue.
